stories.title: Man arrested as vehicle stopped after “travelling wrong side of the A55 this evening on Anglesey”
stories.summary: A man has been arrested after North Wales Police stopped a vehicle travelling on the wrong side of the A55 on Anglesey this evening (Monday 24 August). stories.title: Police appeal to find missing 14-year-old with links to north Wales area

stories.title: Drugs buried at Creamfields site recovered in police searches
stories.summary: Police have dug up drugs buried in the grounds at Creamfields before a single festivalgoer has arrived. stories.title: Flintshire education services cause significant concern, Estyn inspectors find
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council’s education services cause significant concern, the education inspectorate for Wales has found. Estyn published its report today, Monday 24 August, following an inspection of the council’s education services in July. stories.title: Section of Wepre Lane set to return to 30mph and new double yellow lines planned
stories.summary: Two changes to Wepre Lane in Connah’s Quay take effect on 4 September, one covering speed and one covering parking.
